fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready
fieldValues.role_holder: Steward (agent:tpr-steward), convener and liaison; Builder (agent:tpr-builder) and Reviewer (agent:tpr-reviewer) act within the group
fieldValues.authority: Decides itself and auto-merges any change that executes a recorded ruling, RFC or invariant and names it; in mode clear or complicated; within srs-rust, srs-vscode, srs docs and mirror syncs, and non-UI srs-web; with green gates; at most 10 PRs per cycle.
fieldValues.boundary: Escalates, one proposed decision each: any change that would make or change a ruling; Door 2 or Door 3; complex mode; a breaking CLI or payload change; a pin bump in another repo; anything that touches gates or merge rules; going over budget. Outside: new rulings, RFCs, client UX.
fieldValues.source_of_authority: Owner (delegation, once ratified by the owner's charter decision)
fieldValues.revisit_when: No open divergence in the divergence diff for two cycles, or the owner changes the mandate.
